responsibility: This file provides the null GGC backend used by generator programs and build-time tools that need the GGC API surface without actual garbage collection. It implements the allocator entry points as thin wrappers around xmalloc/xcalloc/xrealloc/free, reports allocation sizes without collector rounding, and leaves grow/trim operations as no-ops, allowing code shared with the compiler proper to link without pulling in the full tree-aware collector.
